sloka: सखे राघव धर्मज्ञ रिपूणामपि वत्सल ।अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि गमिष्यामि यथागतम् ।। ६.५०.५६ ।।।।
transliteration: sakhe rāghava dharmajña ripūṇāmapi vatsala ।abhyanujñātumicchāmi gamiṣyāmi yathāgatam ।। 6.50.56 ।।।।

translations.english: "My dear friend! I wish to take leave of you. Truly you are knower of what is right, and you are dear even to an enemy."
